tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List published MojaLab blog posts (title, slug, excerpt, tags, date). Paginated; optionally filter by tag slug, filter by publish date, and sort.

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search published MojaLab posts by keyword or natural-language query. Results are ranked by relevance (0–1) using hybrid lexical + semantic matching. Use excerpt_length for longer previews.

tools.name: search_all
tools.description: Search across all published content — blog posts, static pages/tools, and companion GitHub repositories — ranked by relevance. Each result is prefixed with [post], [page], or [repo].

tools.name: get_site_summary
tools.description: Get a concise overview of mojalab.com in one call: what the site is about, main topics, article/page counts, recent articles, and available tools/pages. Use for questions like "what is mojalab?".

tools.name: get_related_posts
tools.description: Get posts related to a given post (by shared tags and content similarity), for recommendations.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Get the full content of a published MojaLab blog post as Markdown, by slug. Includes any companion repository link.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List all public tags on MojaLab with their post counts and descriptions.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List published static pages on MojaLab (about, tools, ...).

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Get the full content of a published MojaLab static page as Markdown, by slug.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_posts, search_posts, search_all, get_related_posts, get_post, list_tags · Public sink: list_posts, search_all, get_related_posts, get_post, list_tags.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_posts, search_posts, search_all, get_related_posts, get_post, list_tags · Public sink: list_posts, search_all, get_related_posts, get_post, list_tags

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_posts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List published MojaLab blog posts (title, slug, excerpt, tags, date). Paginated; optionally filter by tag slug." → after: "List published MojaLab blog posts (title, slug, excerpt, tags, date). Paginated; optionally filter by tag slug, filter by publish date, and sort."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
